title: 第13章 杨康12第14章 杨康13
content_zh:
丘处机看着又出来一个人，看着十分眼熟，不确定的问道：“你是开封的陈秀才？”
陈秀才淡淡的说道：“难为邱道长还记得老翁，老翁深感荣幸！”
丘处机虽不知陈秀才对他的敌意从何而来，但他自问没有对不起他！
“今年春天在开封，你女儿成婚，我见你家女儿哭哭啼啼，特意帮你们赶跑了逼婚的娶亲之人，你们不感激也就罢了，怎么还怪我呢！而且当时并没有人员伤亡，你全家老小与我又有何干！”
“没有伤亡吗？那是因为伤在心里面！”
“邱道长一把年纪，总不至于连哭嫁这个习俗都不知道吧？”
“我家女儿和未婚夫君情投意合，两家相约春日成亲，花轿前我女儿正在好好的按习俗行礼，你冲出来二话不说，指责新郎强抢民女，直接将他们教训一顿赶走！等老夫从屋子里出来后，新郎已经被你赶走了，而你也不见了！只留下了面面相觑的宾客！”
“你一走了之不说，我们家该怎么办？新郎以为我们家对这门亲事不满，直接就上门退婚！邻里更是对我们家指指点点，还有那些市井无赖跑上门来说我家女儿不检点，才会被人退婚！你让我们家怎么办？"
“流言蜚语让我们根本就没办法安心过日子，我们想搬走，可是往哪搬啊！我们家也只是一般人家，哪有那么多的钱财！我的女儿为了躲避这些，整日以泪洗面，最后悬梁自尽在家中，只希望流言蜚语能消失，老妻受不了女儿去世的打击，没过多久就病逝了，儿子儿媳为了躲避流言蜚语，也带着孙子回了娘家，甚至都不敢回来。短短几个月，我丧妻丧女，身边再无亲人相伴，成为了孤寡老人！”
“好好的一场喜事因为你变成了这样，邱道长，你告诉我，我女儿做错了什么，我们全家做错了什么！”说到最后，陈秀才早已经泣不成声！
听着陈秀才的话，丘处机也回想起当时的情况，虽然新娘在哭，但其他人却都喜气洋洋的，看到自己出现时，很多人都是一副震惊的样子，难不成自己真的误会了？
“邱道长，我不杀伯仁，伯仁却因我而死，你确实没有害我们一家人，但我们一家落到如今的地步跟你脱不了干系！我来终南山的一路上也听到了不少邱道长行侠仗义的事情，但你有关注过后续吗？本来我们付出一点东西就能平平安安的活下去，你们出来行侠仗义，然后被教训的人找不到你们，就把满腔的怒火发泄在我们的身上，我们难道就活该吗？我们只是想活下去啊！”
“还有我，你们在大街上大打出手，损害了多少周边人的货物和摊位，你们拍拍屁股一走了之，我们的损失谁来承担！我们凭什么为你们的斗殴买单！”
“就是，你们自己劫富济贫，你们走了以后主家说我们失职，我们多少人为此丢了性命！人家富有跟你们有什么关系，你们凭什么随意拿别人的东西，那也是别人耗尽心血赚的！”
“我们的命在你们眼里就这么不值钱吗？”
......
丘处机听着耳边的质问，只觉得无言以对，。他自以为的行侠仗义在这些人的嘴里居然变成了罪大恶极，这让他怎么能接受！
看到丘处机被一群人问的说不出话，陈安主动站出来问道：“现在你们还有什么要说的吗？”
说完还看了一眼围观的众人
躲在暗处的洪七公本想出面帮忙的，但听着这一句句的质问，他不由想起自己偷吃了皇宫大内的膳食，那些厨子又会怎么样呢！会不会有人因他而受罚，甚至丢掉性命呢！

他自认自己一生无愧侠义之道，没有对不起任何人，但此刻却觉得脸红。如果真的有人因他偷吃膳食而丢掉性命，那他岂不是......
其他江湖人本身只是来看丘处机的结局，但没想到却听到了这么多的事情。心里不由想起自己平日里，好像也做过不少和丘处机一样的事情，瞬间觉得羞愧！
当然也不是所有人都会反思的，例如欧阳锋就不会！毕竟在欧阳锋看来，这些人能为他做贡献，那是他们的福气！
杨康当然知道欧阳锋的为人处世，说到底，羞愧心这种东西只存在于正道人士，欧阳锋都不在意别人对他的看法，当然也不会理解自己给别人带来的痛苦了！
不过好在欧阳锋只是喜欢武功，日后让他在白驼山庄里面好好练武就行，白驼山庄最终还是要看欧阳克的！
看着没有人说话，场上安静的只剩下这些苦主的哭声，陈安只好从怀里掏出册子，开始念着。
年前，邱道长在洛阳行侠仗义，最终与人发生争执，打斗过程中，共有25个摊位被波及，损失财物二十余两，并无人员伤亡，但也并未赔偿商贩损失；
去年冬季，邱道长在武汉李家庄行侠仗义，因收取保护费问题杀死大宋兵士五人，事后一走了之，导致李家庄因交不出杀人凶手，二十三位村民因在场而被迫顶罪，牵连普通百姓百余人，其中间接死亡十八人。
去年秋季，邱道长在襄阳白山镇行侠仗义，少女林三娘在街上闲逛，被知府公子赵斌调戏，邱道长一怒之下杀害赵斌，事后，知府为替儿子报仇，林三娘全家被杀，邻里被牵连数十人。
去年.......
随着陈安的一句句话，周围除了鸟兽的叫声，再无一点动静！
为了让丘处机印象深刻，杨康特意吩咐陈安从最近的事情开始。
丘处机听着这些事情，只觉得讽刺！自己做过的事情丘处机自然不会不记得，往日里这些是他行侠仗义的光辉，现在却是砍在他身上的刀？
为什么！究竟是为什么！自己是真的想帮助他们的，但为什么会有这么多人被自己牵连呢！他们会不会怪他多管闲事啊！自己这半生到底在做什么啊！心中道义被毁的丘处机忍不住喷出一口血来。
其他人也被吓到了，丘处机做过的事情他们基本上都做过，只是大同小异罢了，那他们做的那些事情后续又是什么样呢？会不会也有无辜的人因他们而受牵连！
众人心里一时间心乱如麻，不知道如何是好！
其实儒以文乱法，侠以武犯禁，这是当权者最讨厌的事情。
content_en:
Qiu Chuji saw another person coming out. He looked very familiar and asked uncertainly, "Are you Chen Xiucai from Kaifeng?"
Chen Xiucai said calmly: "It's hard for Taoist Qiu to still remember the old man. The old man is deeply honored!"
Although Qiu Chuji didn't know where Chen Xiucai's hostility towards him came from, he asked himself that he had not sorry for him!
"This spring in Kaifeng, your daughter got married. I saw your daughter crying, and I went out of my way to help you drive away the bridegroom who was forcing her to get married. It's okay if you're not grateful. How can you blame me? And there were no casualties at the time. What do your whole family have to do with me!"
"Are there no casualties? That's because they are hurt in the heart!"
"Tao Qiu is so old that he doesn't even know the custom of marrying with tears, right?"
"My daughter and her fiancé are in love, and the two families have arranged to get married in the spring. My daughter was bowing in front of the sedan chair according to the customs. You rushed out without saying a word, accused the groom of robbing civilian girls, and directly gave them a lesson and drove them away! When I came out of the house, the groom had been driven away by you, and you were gone! Only the guests who were looking at each other were left!"
"What will our family do if you leave without telling us? The groom thought that our family was dissatisfied with the marriage, so he came to break off the engagement! The neighbors even pointed out our family, and some scoundrels from the market came to our door and said that my daughter was misbehaving, so the engagement was broken off! What do you want our family to do?"
"Rumors and rumors made it impossible for us to live peacefully. We wanted to move, but where to move! Our family is just an ordinary family, how could we have so much money! In order to avoid these, my daughter shed tears all day long, and finally hanged herself from the beam at home, just hoping that the rumors would spread. My wife couldn't bear the shock of my daughter's death, so she died of illness not long after. In order to avoid the rumors, my son and daughter-in-law took their grandson back to their parents' home, and they didn't even dare to come back. In just a few months, I lost my wife and daughter, and I no longer had any relatives around me, and I became a lonely old man!"
"It's such a happy event because you have become like this, Taoist Qiu, tell me what my daughter has done wrong, what our whole family has done wrong!" By the end of the sentence, Chen Xiucai had already burst into tears!
Listening to Chen Xiucai's words, Qiu Chuji also recalled the situation at that time. Although the bride was crying, everyone else was beaming. When they saw him appearing, many people looked shocked. Could it be that he really misunderstood?
"Taoist Qiu, I didn't kill Boren, but Boren died because of me. You did not harm our family, but you have nothing to do with our family's current situation! I heard a lot of Taoist Qiu's chivalrous acts on the way to Zhongnan Mountain, but have you paid attention to it? What’s the follow-up? We should have been able to live peacefully with a little effort, but you came out to do justice, and then the people who were punished couldn’t find you, so they vented their anger on us. Do we deserve it? "
"And me, you fought on the street and damaged the goods and stalls of many people around you. You slapped your butt and walked away. Who will bear our losses! Why should we pay for your fight!"
"That is, you robbed the rich and gave to the poor. After you left, the master said that we were derelict in our duties. How many of us lost our lives because of this! What does other people's wealth have to do with you? Why do you take other people's things at will? They are also earned by other people's hard work!"
"Are our lives so worthless in your eyes?"
...
Qiu Chuji felt speechless as he listened to the questions in his ears. What he thought was a chivalrous and righteous act actually turned into a heinous crime in the words of these people. How could he accept this!
Seeing Qiu Chuji speechless being questioned by a group of people, Chen An took the initiative to stand up and asked, "Do you have anything else to say now?"
After speaking, he glanced at the crowd of people watching.Hong Qigong, who was hiding in the dark, originally wanted to come forward to help, but after hearing these questions, he couldn't help but think of what would happen to the cooks if he stole the food from the palace! Will someone be punished or even lose their life because of him?
He believed that he had lived a life of chivalry and had never wronged anyone, but at this moment he felt blushing. If someone really lost their life because of him stealing food, wouldn't he...
The other Jianghu people only came to see Qiu Chuji's ending, but they didn't expect to hear so many things. I couldn't help but think that I seemed to have done a lot of the same things as Qiu Chuji in my daily life, and I instantly felt ashamed!
Of course, not everyone will reflect on it, for example Ouyang Feng will not! After all, in Ouyang Feng's view, it is their blessing that these people can contribute to him!
Of course Yang Kang knew Ouyang Feng's behavior. In the final analysis, shame only existed among righteous people. Ouyang Feng didn't care what others thought of him, and of course he wouldn't understand the pain he caused to others!
Fortunately, Ouyang Feng just likes martial arts. In the future, he can just let him practice martial arts well in White Camel Villa. In the end, White Camel Villa still depends on Ouyang Ke!
Seeing that no one spoke, and the only sound in the place was the cries of the victims, Chen An had no choice but to take out the booklet from his arms and start reading.
Years ago, Taoist priest Qiu was performing a heroic act in Luoyang, and eventually got into a dispute with someone. During the fight, a total of 25 stalls were affected, and more than 20 taels of property were lost. There were no casualties, but the vendors were not compensated for their losses;
Last winter, Taoist priest Qiu performed a heroic act in Lijiazhuang, Wuhan. He killed five soldiers from the Song Dynasty over the issue of collecting protection money, and then ran away. As a result, Lijiazhuang could not hand over the murderer, and 23 villagers were forced to take the blame because they were present. More than 100 ordinary people were implicated, and 18 of them died indirectly.
Last autumn, Taoist priest Qiu was performing a chivalrous act in Baishan Town, Xiangyang. The young girl Lin Sanniang was wandering on the street and was molested by the prefect's son, Zhao Bin. Taoist priest Qiu killed Zhao Bin in a rage. Afterwards, the prefect wanted to avenge his son. Lin Sanniang's whole family was killed, and dozens of people in the neighborhood were implicated.
Last year......
Following Chen An's words, except for the cries of birds and animals, there was no movement at all!
In order to impress Qiu Chuji, Yang Kang specifically ordered Chen An to start with the most recent events.
When Qiu Chuji heard these things, he felt ironic! Naturally, Qiu Chuji would not forget the things he had done. In the past, these were the glory of his chivalry and righteousness, but now they were the swords that struck him?
Why! Why exactly! I really want to help them, but why are so many people implicated by me? Will they blame him for being nosy? What on earth have you been doing for the rest of your life? Qiu Chuji, whose moral integrity was destroyed in his heart, couldn't help but spit out a mouthful of blood.
Others were also frightened. They had basically done all the things Qiu Chuji had done, but they were mostly the same. So what would happen next to the things they did? Will there be innocent people implicated because of them?
Everyone was confused for a moment and didn't know what to do!
In fact, Confucianism uses literature to disrupt the law, and chivalrous people use force to violate the prohibition. This is the most annoying thing for those in power.
